title.zh: Coinbase Wins CFTC Approval for In-House Derivatives Clearing
title.en: Coinbase Wins CFTC Approval for In-House Derivatives Clearing

current_state.zh: Coinbase received CFTC approval to operate an in-house derivatives clearinghouse for fully collateralized contracts, while continuing to rely on outside partners for margined futures and planned single-stock perpetuals.
